SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
DECLARE @Desde DATETIME = DATEADD(HOUR, 3, CAST('{{ $json.desde }}-01' AS DATETIME));
DECLARE @Hasta DATETIME = DATEADD(HOUR, 3, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, CAST('{{ $json.hasta }}-01' AS DATETIME)));
WITH Movimientos AS (
  SELECT H.IdViaje, H.Fecha,
    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, -3, H.Fecha)), MONTH(DATEADD(HOUR, -3, H.Fecha)), 1) AS Mes
  FROM dbo.HistorialViaje H WITH (NOLOCK)
  INNER JOIN dbo.EstadoViaje EH WITH (NOLOCK) ON EH.Id = H.IdEstado
  WHERE H.Fecha >= @Desde AND H.Fecha < @Hasta
    AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(EH.NombreCompleto))) COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AI
      IN ('procesando como devolucion', 'procesando devolucion')
), Devoluciones AS (
  SELECT IdViaje, Mes, MIN(Fecha) AS Primera, MAX(Fecha) AS Ultima
  FROM Movimientos GROUP BY IdViaje, Mes
)
SELECT D.Mes, V.Id,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), CAST(D.Primera AS DATETIME2(0)) AT TIME ZONE 'Argentina Standard Time', 127) AS PrimeraDevolucion,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(33), CAST(D.Ultima AS DATETIME2(0)) AT TIME ZONE 'Argentina Standard Time', 127) AS UltimaDevolucion,
  E.NombreCompleto AS Estado, U.Alias AS Tienda, V.Direccion AS Destino,
  P.Nombre AS Poligono, CAST(V.FechaProgramado AS DATE) AS FechaProgramado,
  V.Visitas, Driver.Repartidor
FROM Devoluciones D
INNER JOIN dbo.Viaje V WITH (NOLOCK) ON V.Id = D.IdViaje
INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario U WITH (NOLOCK) ON U.Id = V.IdUsuario
LEFT JOIN dbo.EstadoViaje E WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.Id = V.IdEstado
LEFT JOIN dbo.Poligono P WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.Id = V.IdPoligono
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT TOP 1 H.Repartidor FROM dbo.HistorialViaje H WITH (NOLOCK)
  WHERE H.IdViaje = V.Id AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(H.Repartidor)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY H.Fecha DESC, H.Id DESC
) Driver
WHERE U.IdLocalidad = 9 AND U.IdModalidad = 5
ORDER BY D.Mes, V.Id;
